name: Major Mining Sites of Wallonia
description: Four former coal-mining complexes strung across southern Belgium, from near the French border to the east, make up this heritage site: Grand-Hornu, Bois-du-Luc, Bois du Cazier and Blegny-Mine. Together they are the best-preserved of Wallonia's hundreds of collieries. Grand-Hornu pairs pit buildings with an early-19th-century planned workers' town, while Bois-du-Luc's colliery dates back to the late 1600s.
